titan_a_fortification.label: Fortification
titan_a_fortification.description: Titan-A Fortify: Fortifies your ships and 2-13 alliance ships (+25% Critical Hit Damage). Checking this marks you Fortified for combat research that requires Fortify.
provenance_notes: Static +25% critical hit damage comes from the player-facing Titan-A Fortify support text.
Fortified-gated combat research is curated separately in src/data/profile.rs and applied only when this support buff resolves.

titan_a_max_fortification.label: Max fortification
titan_a_max_fortification.description: Titan-A Fortify (max): all Fortified effects +250% base weapon damage. Checking this marks you Fortified for combat research that requires Fortify.
provenance_notes: Max Fortification keeps the Fortify critical damage slice and adds the player-facing +250% base weapon damage support text.
Max-only Fortified combat research is curated separately in src/data/profile.rs and applied only when this support buff resolves.
